description: Renovate owns: tool pins in ci/setup-tools.sh (regex), the npm lockfile for the SBOM tool in ci/sbom-npm (npm), pre-commit hook revs, the python-version in workflows (regex) and the digest-pinned base image in ci/docker/Dockerfile (dockerfile).
GitHub Actions SHA pins are owned by Dependabot (.github/dependabot.yml), so the github-actions manager stays disabled here.
test-*/ fixtures are pinned by hand and deliberately never auto-updated (ignorePaths).
Every update waits 7 days after release (minimumReleaseAge). git-refs has no release timestamps, so the semgrep-rules ref is not held back.

customManagers.description: Bump tool versions in ci/setup-tools.sh, together with the pinned release-asset SHA256 when one follows the version line
Track a git branch head pinned as a commit SHA in ci/setup-tools.sh
Bump python-version pinned in workflow files

packageRules.description: Never update a checksum for an existing version: a re-uploaded release asset must fail CI, not be auto-repinned
Base images stay digest-pinned; Renovate proposes digest bumps rather than tag-only updates
The SBOM tool lockfile: exact versions only, refresh the lockfile so transitive deps stay pinned
